parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **PRE**: 预发
- **TEST**: 测试

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi detach-group-plugin --plugin-id a96926e82f994915a8da40a119374537 --group-id 0009db9c828549768a200320714b8930 --stage-name RELEASE --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DetachGroupPlugin --region cn-hangzhou --StageName RELEASE --PluginId a96926e82f994915a8da40a119374537 --GroupId 0009db9c828549768a200320714b8930
